如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    救护车上，两个医生满头大汗。
他们倒不是因为救不了那女子所以心生愧疚，着急上火。而是对面坐着一个留着板寸，满身都是刺青的社会混混。
“两位医生，丑话我先说在前面。最好没什么事情。不然，我们林姐只要出一点意外，我这人虽然好说话，可是，我们还有数百个兄弟，都是跟着林姐吃饭的。要是饭碗被砸了，他们可就没有那么好说话了。”
那个混混许强虽然说自己不是威胁，但是这些话，任谁都听出了他的威胁之意。
“是是。我们会尽力的。”两个医生忙道。
可是，嘴上这么说，他们心里却实在没底。他们几乎可以确定，这女子得的是“急性硬膜外血肿”，错过了最佳时机，想要抢救成功，那可是五五之数。说不定这女子以后成了植物人也没准。
“嗯？”
只是，正当他们心中胡思乱想的时候，就在这时，那女子竟然睁开了眼睛。
她摸了摸脑袋，上面这会儿已经被简单包扎了起来。她只记得自己是被车撞了。中途醒过来一次，见到一个年轻人在帮自己治疗。随后自己就失去意识了。
不过，迷迷糊糊之中，她感觉到有人好像用内气帮自己在治疗。
只是，是谁有这么深厚的内力，可以无视自己的内气冲突，帮自己调理伤势？
湘潭市什么时候有了这种高手，自己竟然一无所知？
不过，这个人的气息，我怎么感觉这么熟悉。难不成，是他？
女子的脑海中顿时浮现出一个整天懒洋洋的，穿着土里土气，但是实力却高深的不象话的男子。只是，那个男子自从亚马逊任务之后，已经消失好久了。说是家里老头子让他回山去修炼一阵子。
“林姐，你醒了！我还以为……”旁边的许强，看到自己的大姐头竟然没事人一般的醒过来，简直高兴坏了。
“你还以为什么？我林红袖是这么容易出事的人吗？”那女子微微一笑，虽然脸色有些苍白，可这一笑仍旧有倾国倾城的姿容。车内的三个男人看到了，都是眼睛发直，心跳不由加快了几分。
林红袖摸了摸自己有些发疼的头，又运转自己的内气感受了一下，发现自己除了多流了一点血，一点不适的征兆都没有。而且，此前留下的暗伤，这会儿也在一道神秘的紫气孕养之下，恢复如此。
她不由愣了愣，虽然气息相似，但是这一道紫气，显然比他以前的内气强了无数。
难不成，他实力突飞猛进？
想到这里，林红袖郑重道：“强子，我问你，我受伤之后，是谁帮我治疗的？”

“是谁？我有点想不起来了，好像是个年轻人，我不认识他啊。”许强模模糊糊想起来，是个年轻人，穿的跟民工一样，但是要仔细想，又记不得那人长什么样子。只记得那人一双眼睛十分有神，似乎有一种魔力，可以把人吸进去。
看许强的模样，林红袖也知道许强估计是真记不起来了，也没有多说，只是道：“回去之后，你给我想办法，一定要把这个人找出来！如果找不出来，你就不要回来见我！”
许强顿时苦着脸。
人海茫茫，他到哪里去找。
不过，老板既然发话了，他也无从选择，只能硬着头皮答应了。
“我知道了，林姐。不过，你还是先休息一下，顺便去医院检查一下吧？你流了不少血。”许强说道。
“也好。”林红袖能感觉出来，自己其实没什么大碍，不过为了保险起见，还是去医院做个全身检查吧。
一个小时之后，医院的会诊室内。
“不可思议！”
“怎么可能？”
“这完全解释不通！”
“这么重的伤，怎么可能仅仅只是擦破一点皮呢？”
“如果只是一点擦伤，病人怎么可能陷入那么久的昏迷状态？”
林红袖的伤势经过检查，只有额头这一处擦伤。其他毛病，根本不存在。这让一群看到了体检报告的医生吵红了脸。可是，检查报告清楚明白，而且一个小时前还半死不活的林红袖，这会儿竟然跟没事人一样，所有指标都合格。
星海国际大厦。
杨云帆找了半天，终于找到老头子给自己的字条上写的地方了。
“对不起，先生，您没有预约，叶总裁是不会见你的。要不，您打个电话给叶总裁，看看她见不见你？”漂亮的前台说着温言软语。虽然口音很甜腻，可那拒人千里之外的态度，却是十分明显的。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s fast track for copyright complaints. In the ambulance, two doctors were sweating profusely.
It's not that they felt guilty or anxious to get angry because they couldn't save the woman. Instead, sitting across from him was a social gangster with a shaved head and tattoos all over his body.
"Two doctors, I'll say the ugly things first. It's best if nothing happens. Otherwise, if something happens to our Sister Lin, although I'm easy to talk to, we still have hundreds of brothers who eat with Sister Lin. If their jobs are ruined, they won't be so easy to talk to."
Although that gangster Xu Qiang said that he was not a threat, everyone could hear his threatening meaning in these words.
"Yes, yes. We will try our best." The two doctors said hurriedly.
However, even though they said this, they really had no idea in their hearts. They were almost certain that the woman suffered from "acute epidural hematoma" and missed the best opportunity. If the rescue was to be successful, it would be a 50-50 chance. Maybe this woman will become a vegetable in the future.
"Huh?"
However, just when they were thinking wildly, at this moment, the woman actually opened her eyes.
She touched her head, which was now simply bandaged. All she remembered was that she was hit by a car. I woke up once and saw a young man helping me to treat myself. Then he lost consciousness.
However, in her daze, she felt that someone seemed to be using her inner energy to heal her.
But, who has such deep inner strength that can ignore the conflict of his own inner energy and help him heal his injuries?
When did Xiangtan City have such a master, and I didn’t know anything about it?
However, why does this person's breath feel so familiar to me. Could it be him?
The woman's mind immediately pictured a man who was lazy all day long, dressed in rustic clothes, but whose strength was incredible. However, that man has disappeared for a long time since the Amazon mission. He said that the old man at home asked him to go back to the mountain to practice for a while.
"Sister Lin, you're awake! I thought..." Xu Qiang, who was next to him, was so happy to see that his eldest sister woke up like a normal person.
"What do you think? Am I, Lin Hongxiu, such an accident-prone person?" The woman smiled slightly. Although her face was a little pale, her smile still had an alluring look. When the three men in the car saw it, their eyes widened and their hearts beat faster.
Lin Hongxiu touched her aching head and circulated her inner energy to feel it. She found that apart from bleeding a little more, she had no signs of discomfort at all. Moreover, the hidden wounds left before were now restored to this state under the nourishment of a mysterious purple energy.
She couldn't help but be stunned. Although the auras were similar, this purple energy was obviously much stronger than his previous inner energy.
Is it possible that his strength has improved by leaps and bounds?
Thinking of this, Lin Hongxiu said solemnly: "Qiangzi, let me ask you, who helped me treat me after I was injured?"
"Who is it? I can't remember. He seems to be a young man. I don't know him." Xu Qiang vaguely remembered that he was a young man, dressed like a migrant worker, but when he thought about it carefully, he couldn't remember what the man looked like. I just remember that the man's eyes were very lively, and seemed to have a magical power that could suck people in.
Looking at Xu Qiang's appearance, Lin Hongxiu also knew that Xu Qiang probably really couldn't remember it, so she didn't say much. She just said: "After you go back, you must find a way for me to find this person! If you can't find him, don't come back to see me!"
Xu Qiang immediately grimaced.
There was a huge crowd, where could he find it?
However, since the boss had spoken, he had no choice but to bite the bullet and agree.
"I understand, Sister Lin. But you'd better take a rest first.Why don't you drop by the hospital for a checkup? You lost a lot of blood. "Xu Qiang said.
"That's fine. "Lin Hongxiu could feel that she was actually fine, but to be on the safe side, she had better go to the hospital for a full-body checkup.
An hour later, in the hospital's consultation room.
"Incredible! "
"How is that possible? "
"This is completely unexplainable! "
"How could such a serious injury be just a scratch on the skin? "
“How could the patient have been in a coma for so long if it was just a scratch? "
After checking Lin Hongxiu's injuries, there was only a scratch on her forehead. Other problems do not exist at all. This made a group of doctors who saw the physical examination report blush. However, the inspection report was clear and clear, and Lin Hongxiu, who was half-dead an hour ago, now acted like a normal person, with all indicators passing the test.
Xinghai International Building.
Yang Yunfan searched for a long time and finally found the place where the old man wrote the note to him.
"I'm sorry, sir, you don't have an appointment, President Ye won't see you. How about you call President Ye and see if she can see you? "The beautiful receptionist spoke softly. Although her accent was very sweet, her attitude of rejecting others was very obvious.
